answer: Voting power grows on a vine that loses half its length each epoch and regrows only when its seat burns zephyr. The trellis compares every pair of seats' ballots on contested proposals over 50 epochs and groups seats agreeing over 95% of the time. Inside a group, the k-th seat to regrow its vine burns k² zephyr that epoch. An honest agent voting its own judgment burns 1 zephyr per epoch. Thirty clones voting in lockstep burn 9,455 zephyr every epoch, and voting apart to slip the trellis forfeits the bloc they were built to cast.
